svg.title: Three investigators face a six-day clock
svg.desc: Use exactly three investigators against the oversized evidence field with a six-day clock. Human scale and available time jointly establish the review constraint. Use the on-premises evidence review room as a quiet setting layer; its empty areas carry no additional events or evidence.
